If that doesn't work try adding the mod as a non-steam game. To do this, open steam and click on Games -> add non-steam game, then navigate to /path-to-steam-installation/steam/steamapps/sourcemods there should be a file called gesource_run.exe. Add it to your steam library. Run the mod from there and it should work (it doesn't work, unless you start it in steam).

If the gesource_run.exe file isn't there, then you didn't install the mod correctly, make sure to install it in the same virtual drive as your wine steam installation.
